fullContent:
Brahmi Drakshadi Kashayam 
 Reference – Sahasrayogam 
 Introduction 
 Brahmi Drakshadi Kashayam is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to contain fruitful herbs. This formulation is known to treat the vata dosha related disorders. This is known to contain many effective herbs but out of them brahmi and draksha are known as very important herbs. Brahmi is known to contain memory-enhancing, anti-oxidants, immune-modulatory, anti-anxiety, anti-inflammatory etc. properties and draksha is known to contain anti-oxidant, laxative, stomachic, diuretic and cooling etc. properties. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Trikatu – Pepper, Long pepper and Ginger 
 Vacha – Acorus calamus 
 Shatavari – Asparagus racemosus 
 Brahmi – Bacopa monnieri 
 Draksha – Vitis vinifera 
 Musta – Cyperus rotundus 
 Shamyaka – Cassia fistula 
 Pathya – Terminalia chebula 
 Dhatri – Emblica officinalis 
 Dashamoola – group of ten roots 
 Tikta – Picrorhiza kurroa 
 Neem – Azadirachta indica 
 Koshataki – Luffa echinata 
 Devadaru – Cedrus deodara 
 Vibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica 
 Bala – Sida cordifolia 
 Bhunimba – Andrographis paniculata 
 Vahni – Plumbago zeylanica 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the herbs in equal quantity in a pot. 
 Water is added to that pot and pot is heated then. 
 Do the process till the water reduced to its one-fourth level. 
 Now water decoction of herbs are prepared. 
 
 Dose 
 5 to 10 ml, one to two times a day, before meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Muscle stiffness 
 Headaches 
 Neuralgia 
 Loss of movement 
 Myalgia 
 Paralysis 
 Arthritis 
 Aches 
 Burning sensations 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Specifically no contraindications. 
 Take medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Precautions should be taken during pregnancy. 
 Take under medical prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
